critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 611-line file — manageable but consider splitting into routers (users/shifts/swaps/leaves) if it grows.

Endpoint DELETE /api/shifts/month/{month} is registered AFTER DELETE /api/shifts/{shift_id}; FastAPI matches by registration order so '/shifts/month/xxx' is correctly routed to delete_month (verified via test). Good.

shifts generator correctly skips users on approved leave and avoids double-booking same day; total_load and holiday_load drive fair rotation. Algorithm verified — Feb 2026 produces 336 shifts with exactly 1 Autista + 1 Capoturno + 2 Soccorritori per shift.
MongoDB _id properly excluded via projection on every query. Good.
No input validation on date strings (YYYY-MM-DD) for shifts/leaves — relies on consumers. Consider adding pydantic validator.
create_notification uses dict.copy() before insert to keep returned object clean. Good pattern.
seed_data_creation: Tests created/cleaned-up TEST_ scoped data: a 2027-01 generated month (deleted), one ad-hoc 2027-06-15 shift (deleted), a 2027-08-01..10 approved leave for Marco Rossi (left in DB — pending status moved to approved).
